name: The Garden Of Eden
overview: The Garden of Eden, as described in Genesis 2, reveals God's intentional creation and provision for mankind. The LORD God planted a garden in Eden and placed the man He formed there to cultivate and keep it, highlighting humanity's original role and purpose. This garden contained every tree pleasing to the eye and good for food, including the tree of life and the tree of knowledge of good and evil, emphasizing the gift of life and the presence of divine boundaries. A river flowing from Eden to water the garden further illustrates God's sustaining care for His creation.
